measures.label_th: จังหวัดที่มีหลักฐานกิจกรรมหรือความครอบคลุมโครงการ
measures.requested_label_th: พื้นที่เป้าหมาย
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT province_code with qualifying programme coverage evidence
measures.scope: Qualifying programme activity, area, product, participation and innovation-use evidence across supplied sources
measures.limitations: 77 provinces with some programme evidence does not establish complete data for every KPI in every province. Institution-only addresses do not qualify.
measures.drilldown: Province -> coverage assertions -> source record

measures.label_th: พื้นที่วัฒนธรรมตามทะเบียนที่ใช้ในชุดส่งมอบ
measures.requested_label_th: พื้นที่วัฒนธรรม
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT eligible global_area_id; 16 AtLocal + 476 Cultural Map - 1 supported overlap
measures.scope: AtLocal areas and Cultural Map Cultural Space subjects
measures.limitations: Other mapped categories are not automatically cultural areas. Unresolved possible identities remain separately provisional.
measures.drilldown: Area -> source memberships -> names, descriptions, locations and source records

measures.label_th: นวัตกรตามยอดรวมที่ PMUA รายงาน
measures.requested_label_th: สร้างนวัตกรชุมชน
measures.formula: SUM PMUA innovators_all province total_inno; reconcile to reported headline
measures.scope: PMUA all-scope captured aggregate, without a year filter
measures.limitations: 76 supplied province entries. Missing province entry means unavailable, not zero. Named-person companions cannot explain or be subtracted from this total. Levels retain source labels without inferred skill meaning.
measures.drilldown: Province and source-reported level within province; no individual roster for the headline

measures.label_th: กิจกรรมโครงการที่มีรายงาน
measures.requested_label_th: เกิดกิจกรรมทางวัฒนธรรมรวม
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_activity_id in accepted reported activities
measures.scope: AtLocal, Cultural Map and iCommunity reported occurrences, including workshops and meetings
measures.limitations: Publications and sessions are not additional activities. Source-reported occurrence does not prove completion. Overseas activities remain in the overall total.
measures.drilldown: Activity -> publications, dates, venues and sessions

measures.label_th: นวัตกรรมที่มีหลักฐานความพร้อมตามเกณฑ์
measures.requested_label_th: เทคโนโลยีที่เหมาะสมและนวัตกรรมพร้อมใช้
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_innovation_id with at least one eligible readiness assessment
measures.scope: iCommunity, PMUA AppTech, RINMP and AppTech MRU after accepted identity resolution
measures.limitations: Numeric 8-9 qualifies; valid numeric level takes precedence over a label within an assessment. Explicit ready label is fallback only. Apply iCommunity export-first and proven supersession. Preserve conflicts; no canonical maximum or verified-current claim.
measures.drilldown: Innovation -> all readiness assertions, source identities and use locations

measures.label_th: ธุรกิจ ร้านค้า และกลุ่มผู้ดำเนินการที่มีหลักฐานรองรับ
measures.requested_label_th: ผู้ประกอบการจำหน่ายสินค้าและบริการเชิงวัฒนธรรม
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_operator_id after reviewed business admission and accepted identity reconciliation
measures.scope: Accepted catalogue businesses plus reviewed Learning directory, Cultural Map/AtLocal narratives and iCommunity/PMUA/RINMP/MRU business evidence; seven sources contribute
measures.limitations: Partial coverage of reviewed evidence, not a complete business population. Shops and supported producers qualify; people, projects and unspecified households do not each create a business. Learning directory evidence does not create a K07 product. Unresolved eligibility is excluded; admitted possible duplicates retain flags. Unknown business geography is not borrowed from products or projects.
measures.drilldown: Business -> crosswalk -> seller/reviewed evidence -> confirmed product relationships and supported locations

measures.label_th: ผู้ประกอบการวัฒนธรรม — ยังไม่คำนวณในชุดส่งมอบนี้
measures.requested_label_th: ผู้ประกอบการวัฒนธรรม
measures.formula: Not calculated in this release
measures.scope: Future systematic person-role-business discovery and qualification
measures.limitations: The original 58-person inventory reflects uneven, incomplete discovery. User deferred calculation entirely. Neither 58 nor the 156-person pilot is a released result; absence of a total does not mean absence of supporting examples.
measures.drilldown: Method and deferral explanation only

measures.label_th: ตระกูลสินค้า บริการ และผลงานที่มีหลักฐานรองรับ
measures.requested_label_th: พัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์และบริการเชิงวัฒนธรรม
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT family_id; ordinary variants within a supported maker context share one family; a broad range adds no extra parent count
measures.scope: Accepted catalogue offerings plus reviewed actual outputs, prototypes, completed designs and systems from AtLocal, Cultural Map, iCommunity, PMUA, RINMP and AppTech MRU; Learning directory-only product claims excluded
measures.limitations: Partial reviewed coverage. Existence or sale does not prove programme development. Ordinary flavour/filling/colour/size variants count once per supported family; distinct finished forms and confirmed designs remain separate. Global offering row count is not the KPI. Unenumerated totals are non-additive. Known unresolved identity and geography limitations remain visible.
measures.drilldown: Family -> offering_family_members -> preserved offering identities -> listings/reviewed evidence, variants, innovation context, relationships, locations, prices and media

measures.label_th: ธุรกิจชุมชนที่พัฒนาขีดความสามารถ — ยังไม่คำนวณในชุดส่งมอบนี้
measures.requested_label_th: พัฒนาขีดความสามารถของผู้ประกอบการในธุรกิจชุมชน
measures.formula: Not calculated; accepted narrower score-linked business measure also deferred
measures.scope: Future business/group identity linked to an affiliated person's complete positive assessment in relevant context
measures.limitations: 984 participating units do not prove improvement. 163 people with increased scores are not 163 businesses. Person-business membership and business deduplication are not finalized; qualitative improvement cannot replace numeric score evidence.
measures.drilldown: Separate participation and person-assessment companions only

measures.label_th: การจ้างงานในพื้นที่ตามที่แหล่งข้อมูลรายงาน
measures.requested_label_th: เกิดรายได้จากการจ้างงานในพื้นที่
measures.formula: SUM six regional localEmployeeAmount values
measures.scope: Learning dashboard employment aggregate
measures.limitations: Employment count, not an income amount. No employee/business roster or province allocation. Monthly source unit does not identify the observation calendar month.
measures.drilldown: Six regional employment components

measures.label_th: เงินที่รายงานว่าจ่ายแก่แรงงานและผู้จัดหาทรัพยากรในพื้นที่
measures.requested_label_th: สร้างรายได้กลับสู่ท้องถิ่น
measures.formula: (SUM localEmployeeExpense + SUM localResourceExpense) / 1000000 = (11701018 + 12368490) / 1000000
measures.scope: Learning dashboard regional worker payments and resource spending
measures.limitations: Assumes additive local receipts without overlap and compatible monthly periods. Not verified net income. Display 24.1, retain exact 24.069508. Do not add the alternative or Wallet totals.
measures.drilldown: Six regions and worker/resource components; underlying THB amounts retained

measures.label_th: คลัสเทอร์อุตสาหกรรม — ไม่มีข้อมูลเพียงพอ
measures.requested_label_th: ขับเคลื่อนคลัสเทอร์อุตสาหกรรมในพื้นที่
measures.formula: Unavailable; no supported cluster inventory
measures.scope: Supplied snapshots
measures.limitations: Industry category labels do not establish distinct cluster identities. Null is not zero.
measures.drilldown: Insufficiency explanation only

measures.label_th: จังหวัดที่มีคลัสเทอร์ — ไม่มีข้อมูลเพียงพอ
measures.requested_label_th: จังหวัดที่มีคลัสเทอร์อุตสาหกรรม
measures.formula: Unavailable; no supported cluster-province relationships
measures.scope: Supplied snapshots
measures.limitations: General programme provinces cannot substitute for cluster geography. Null is not zero.
measures.drilldown: Insufficiency explanation only

measures.label_th: รายการทุนหรือเรื่องทางวัฒนธรรมในแผนที่หลังขจัดรายการซ้ำ
measures.requested_label_th: ระบบสารสนเทศด้านวัฒนธรรมและแผนที่วัฒนธรรม
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT eligible Cultural Map map_inspiration subject_id
measures.scope: All map_inspiration categories after accepted source deduplication
measures.limitations: Counts mapped subjects, not information systems or websites. Multiple category memberships do not add subjects. Other sources do not expand this user-defined population.
measures.drilldown: Subject -> listings, descriptions, categories, media and locations

measures.label_th: บุคคลที่มีหลักฐานนวัตกรชุมชนในทะเบียน
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_person_id in community_innovator contributions
measures.scope: Available named-person role inventory
measures.limitations: Related inventory; overlap with PMUA aggregate is unestablished. Never add to or subtract from 12251.
measures.drilldown: Person -> qualifying role assertions -> source identity

measures.label_th: บุคคลตามนิยามนวัตกรที่กว้างขึ้น
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_person_id in broader_innovator contributions
measures.scope: Community innovators, inventors and explicitly identified innovators
measures.limitations: Includes C02_COMMUNITY. Researcher or owner alone does not qualify. Never sum these inventories.
measures.drilldown: Person -> qualifying role assertions -> source identity

measures.label_th: นวัตกรรมที่มีรายการทั้งหมด
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_innovation_id in broader listed inventory
measures.scope: Four innovation sources after accepted identity resolution
measures.limitations: Includes K04. Records without qualifying readiness may have missing evidence rather than proven unreadiness.
measures.drilldown: Innovation -> source records and all readiness evidence

measures.label_th: ธุรกิจหรือหน่วยธุรกิจที่มีหลักฐานเข้าร่วมโครงการ
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT contributing Learning area-based business_id
measures.scope: Learning area-based participating-business directory
measures.limitations: 967 provisional units and 17 supported merged businesses. Participation is not improvement. Not an established parent population of person assessments or the 375 aggregate.
measures.drilldown: Business unit -> participations, projects, research units, locations and source records

measures.label_th: ธุรกิจตามยอดรวม Learning dashboard
measures.formula: SUM counts within each independent dimension; each reconciles to 375
measures.scope: Learning dashboard four independent marginal breakdowns
measures.limitations: No business roster or joint cross-tab. Never sum dimensions or add to 984. A missing member is unavailable unless the source explicitly reports zero.
measures.drilldown: One supplied count dimension at a time

measures.label_th: บุคคลที่มีชุดคะแนนก่อนและหลังครบ
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global person linked to a complete iCommunity assessment
measures.scope: 352 complete source-reported assessments, with within-assessment score pairs
measures.limitations: Multiple assessments per person do not add people. Undated source assessments are not a verified latest score.
measures.drilldown: Person -> assessments -> start/current scores by dimension and observation context

measures.label_th: บุคคลที่รายงานคะแนนเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างน้อยหนึ่งด้าน
measures.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global person with at least one complete assessment having any dimension delta > 0
measures.scope: iCommunity complete assessment pairs
measures.limitations: Subset of C08_ASSESSED_PEOPLE, not businesses. Mixed increases/decreases remain visible. Missing assessments do not imply no improvement.
measures.drilldown: Person -> qualifying and other assessments -> each dimension's scores and delta

measures.label_th: สูตรทางเลือกเพื่ออธิบายตัวเลขรายได้เดิม
measures.formula: (SUM localResourceExpense + excludedResourceExpense) / 1000000 = (12368490 + 200093000) / 1000000
measures.scope: Learning dashboard resource spending and separate excluded-resource amount
measures.limitations: Display 212.5. Excluded amount meaning and monthly-period compatibility remain assumptions. Matching the old display is not verification. Never add this alternative to K10.
measures.drilldown: Regional resource amounts and the separately labelled excluded amount
